lore: Some say the dead keep a ledger. This shrine is where it is kept, and its soul flame never forgets a name.
use: Open it to see where the items of your last death went: still lying (with a despawn bar), picked up by you or someone else, burned, despawned, fallen into the void or gone another way - each in its own color, with a legend beside the list.
secret: A paused bar means the chunk is not loaded and the timer stands. Soulbound items never appear: they never left you.
